rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese way to say Wednesday.

example.english: We have a meeting on Wednesday.
example.jyutping: sing1 kei4 saam1 ngo5 dei6 hoi1 wui2

rows.note: Use this common colloquial alternative to 星期三 in everyday conversation.

example.english: Let's have lunch together on Wednesday.
example.traditional: 禮拜三得閒一齊食飯啦。
example.jyutping: lai5 baai3 saam1 dak1 haan4 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6 laa1

rows.note: Use this shorter written or news-style form rather than the usual spoken forms.

example.jyutping: zau1 saam1 hei3 wan1 wui5 dit3
